hints.title: Robot Simulation Loop
hints.text: Simulate the robot trajectory step-by-step from the top-left cell facing right.

hints.title: Clockwise Rotation
hints.text: Upon hitting an obstacle or boundary, rotate ninety degrees clockwise without changing position.

hints.title: Cycle Detection
hints.text: Terminate simulation when a previously seen cell and direction combination is re-encountered.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Simulation terminates when the robot repeats a (row, col, direction) state.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to track direction in visited states leads to premature loop termination.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 4-bit directional bitmask per cell provides compact O(1) state lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that a state is defined by coordinate and direction.
